purpose: Stable project-owned geometry identities for rendered map geometries that do not have a usable source ID. Project IDs are not ISO numeric codes and must not be presented as such.

N. Cyprus.note: Stable DROPi geometry/catalog key for serialization and locality lookup. Geographic rendering does not assert universally settled sovereignty or recognition.

Somaliland.note: Stable DROPi geometry/catalog key for serialization and locality lookup. This key represents the rendered geography only and does not assert universally settled sovereignty or recognition.

Kosovo.note: Stable DROPi geometry/catalog key for serialization and locality lookup. This identifier does not assert universally settled sovereignty or ISO recognition.
